isFormatValid
	(number allSatisfy: [ :char | char isDigit ]) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid DNI number' ].
	| dniNumber |
	dniNumber := Integer readFrom: number readStream.
	(dniNumber between: 1 and: 99999999) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid DNI number' ].
	^true

isFormatValid
	(number size between: 12 and: 13) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid CUIT number' ].
	(number third = $- and: [ number penultimate = $- ]) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid CUIT number' ].
	({ '20'. '23'. '24'. '25'. '26'. '27'. '30'. '33'. '34'. } includes: (number first: 2)) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid CUIT number' ].
	number last isDigit ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid CUIT number' ].
	((number copyFrom: 4 to: number size - 2) allSatisfy: [ :char | char isDigit ]) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid CUIT number' ].
	^true

isFormatValid
	(value allSatisfy: [ :char | char isDigit ]) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid old zipcode' ].
	| numericValue |
	numericValue := value asNumber.
	(numericValue between: 1000 and: 9999) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid old zipcode' ].
	^true

isFormatValid
	value size ~= 8 ifTrue: [ self error: 'Invalid new zipcode' ].
	(value first isLetter) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid identification type' ].
	| newZipcodeOldZipCode |
	newZipcodeOldZipCode := value copyFrom: 2 to: 5.
	(newZipcodeOldZipCode allSatisfy: [ :char | char isDigit ]) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid new zipcode' ].
	newZipcodeOldZipCode asNumber > 999 ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid new zipcode' ].
	((value last: 3) allSatisfy: [ :char | char isLetter ]) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Invalid new zipcode' ].
	^true
